articles.title: Quoting Prompting Claude Fable 5.2
articles.summary: Claude Fable 5.2 responds closely to what the prompt says about who owns the code it works on. In Anthropic’s testing on small coding tasks, when a prompt said nothing about ownership or presented the code base as someone else’s, the model tended to add to the existing structure, even when that repeated existing code. articles.title: Glue work is still harmful in the age of AI
articles.summary: I am not a believer in glue work1. Processes that can only be sustained by the unrewarded sacrifice of engineers ought to die. Now that LLMs are writing most of our code, does that free human engineers up to do more glue work? No, it doesn’t. I think glue work is actually less important to companies than it was in the 2010s. articles.summary: I love working with designers, in part because (unlike managers and product managers) they’re culturally different from engineers.
